scene: Atop the lighthouse, breezy transit platforms stretch out to three new districts.
picture: A flat side view of the wide lighthouse observation platform. On the left, a bright red double-decker bus waits at a gangway. Centre, the dark-haired boy holds his skateboard and melting blue ice cream next to an open rope lift. On the right, a yellow skate shuttle sits with doors wide open.
shown: a red double-decker bus waiting at a ramp on the left
an open woven rope-bridge lift dangling in the centre
a yellow ramp-shaped skate shuttle docked on the right
